contracts.actorTerrain: 441b00 guards creature, reference and reference.world actor, then bound!=-1, grounded bytes, matching signed-short ground index and inclusive terrain transform height<=actor Y. Uses supplied actor, not primary global.
contracts.actorPlatform: 4410f0 guards bound, creature and reference, but does not guard reference.world actor. It then applies the actor grounded/terrain height test and scans ordered member ground-object IDs. Null actor after those guards is outside its native domain.
